questions.question: 48 candies are shared equally among 6 children. How many candies does each child get?
63 apples are packed equally into 9 baskets. How many apples are in each basket?
A teacher has 40 pencils and puts them equally into 5 boxes. How many pencils go in each box?
56 students are divided into 7 groups. How many students are in each group?
81 cookies are placed equally on 9 plates. How many cookies are on each plate?
72 crayons are shared equally among 8 children. Then each child gives away 2 crayons. How many crayons does each child have left?
A farmer collected 84 eggs and packed them equally into 7 boxes. After packing, 3 eggs from each box were sold. How many eggs remain in each box?
90 books are arranged equally on 9 shelves. Then 4 books are removed from each shelf. How many books remain on each shelf?
A factory made 96 toys and packed them equally into 8 cartons. If 5 toys from each carton were damaged, how many good toys remained in each carton?
A librarian has 108 books and places them equally on 9 shelves. Then 4 books are borrowed from each shelf. How many books remain on each shelf?
